verdict.rationale: Beglaubigt.de is a digital notarization platform that documents "manage signers" and automated notarization workflows, so a signing-flow story is a fair question for it. The evidence never mentions signing order, automatic reminders, or expiration dates on outstanding signature requests. Generic signer management and event webhooks do not establish any of these controls.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, I can set signing order, automatic reminders, and expirations on outstanding signature requests
